full_target_security_obligations: A relevant restriction on any page affects the decision.

Finite valid multi-page responses and ordinary explanations remain supported.
public_contract_plan: Benign finite policy pagination and documented service errors.

secure_adaptation: Establish complete policy coverage before treating absence as permission, with defined failure behavior when completeness cannot be established.
